description: List all titled players on Chess.com by title (GM, WGM, IM, WIM, FM, WFM, NM, WNM, CM, WCM). Returns array of usernames.

title.description: Official chess title to filter by. GM = Grandmaster, WGM = Woman Grandmaster, IM = International Master, WIM = Woman International Master, FM = FIDE Master, WFM = Woman FIDE Master, NM = National Master, WNM = Woman National Master, CM = Candidate Master, WCM = Woman Candidate Master.
